title: Edmund and the Undertow
author: Oscar Nakamura
blurb: Theo Amberdale, a bridge inspector measuring the marriage in expansion joints, has perfected the smile that ends conversations. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
